identity.vendor: Artell (independent developer, distributed via Superhive Market / Blender Market)

keyLimits.en: Core rigging functionality only, includes 12 months of support and updates.
Core plus Smart tool (automatic biped bone placement), FBX/GLTF export for game engines, and animation retargeting (Remap tool); includes 12 months of support and updates.

addOns.en: Support/update extension beyond the initial 12 months costs 25% of the product price annually.

cautions.en: Perpetual license usable across Blender 2.93 to 5.2 at time of check, but support and updates beyond 12 months require an additional paid extension.

capabilities.en: Automatic bone placement solver for biped humanoid characters, generating an articulated rig from mesh recognition.
Modular rig customization: fingers, toes, ears, tail and spine variations, plus advanced facial rigging with automated setup.
Animation retargeting (Remap tool) and FBX/GLTF export presets for Unity, Unreal Engine, and Godot.

limitations.en: Automatic Smart placement works primarily for humanoid bipeds; quadrupeds and other creature types require manual rig setup.
Automatic skinning results depend on water-tight mesh geometry, which not all source models provide.

reason.en: Auto-Rig Pro is an add-on built specifically on top of Blender's native rigging tools.

missingAlternatives.name: Mixamo
missingAlternatives.reason: Free auto-rigging and animation service for humanoid characters, a common alternative to manual Blender rigging add-ons.

unknowns: No stated region/currency variation was found; prices are assumed USD as displayed on the Superhive Market listing.
